findings.title: Zielony `Check` maskuje nowszy, nieudany wymagany `ci / Check`, więc kontrola gałęzi bazowej przepuszcza uruchomienie sesji.
findings.reproduce: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { receiverGaps } from "./src/cli/lane-run/receiver.ts"; import { REQUIRED_CHECK_APP_ID as id } from "./src/repo/ci-admission-contract.ts"; const row = (name, conclusion, started_at) => ({name, conclusion, started_at, status: "completed", app: {id}}); const gaps = receiverGaps("main", {repo: JSON.stringify({default_branch: "main", allow_auto_merge: true}), branch: JSON.stringify({protection: {required_status_checks: {checks: [{context: "ci / Check", app_id: id}]}}}), rules: "[]", checkRuns: JSON.stringify({check_runs: [row("Check", "success", "2026-11-17T10:00:00Z"), row("ci / Check", "failure", "2026-11-17T10:05:00Z")]})}); assert.match(gaps.join("\n"), /baseline is red/);'
